case_title: JAGROOP SINGH v. STATE OF PUNJAB
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.34; Arms Act s.27
aggravating_circumstances: Last seen with deceased, extra-judicial confession, weapon recovery, blood on weapon
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of murder and culpable homicide, sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused, along with another individual, were last seen with the deceased, a 10-year-old boy. The deceased was found dead in a field after a search. The accused made an extra-judicial confession admitting guilt, which was voluntary and not tainted. A spade, stained with human blood, was recovered based on the accused's disclosure. The weapon was found to have caused injuries consistent with the deceased's wounds. The prosecution established the circumstances linking the accused to the crime, and the courts found the evidence sufficient to prove guilt beyond reasonable doubt.
